queryMethod: unauthenticated GET against OpenRouter's public /api/v1/models and /api/v1/models/{author}/{slug}:free/endpoints - metadata only, no chat completion, no API key used, no cost incurred
reason: The only endpoint OpenRouter routes qwen/qwen3.8-27b:free through (ModelRun, tag modelrun/fp4) does not list 'response_format' in its supported_parameters. It lists the vaguer 'structured_outputs' capability flag alone, which OpenRouter's own schema does not treat as sufficient to accept a response_format payload - the parameter that actually carries json_schema/strict. The experiment design mandates require_parameters=true and allow_fallbacks=false; with exactly one provider serving this free slug and no fallback permitted, a request naming response_format would either be silently dropped (defeating the strict-schema requirement without saying so) or rejected by routing (require_parameters=true refusing a provider that does not support every named parameter) - both are exactly the 'faked support' outcomes the experiment explicitly forbids. No inference call was made to verify this by trial: the metadata is unambiguous enough on its own that sending a real request to find out would itself be treated as silently downgrading the experiment's own gate.

requiredForExperiment.stream: supported_parameters list does not distinguish streaming support; not evaluated further because the schema gate above already blocks
requiredForExperiment.reasoningNoneEquivalent: reasoning/reasoning_effort/include_reasoning are all listed as supported; this alone is not sufficient to proceed
requiredForExperiment.requireParametersTrueAllowFallbacksFalse: would have exactly one candidate provider (ModelRun) and no fallback; compatible with the routing requirement itself, but moot given the schema block above

comparisonAggregateVsActualEndpoint.note: The top-level /api/v1/models aggregate entry for qwen/qwen3.8-27b:free lists supported_parameters as the union across all endpoints OpenRouter could ever route this slug to, not what the one endpoint that actually serves the :free tag supports. The /endpoints call above is the authoritative, single source of truth for what will actually be used, and is what this verdict is based on.

decisionsNotTaken: did not downgrade response_format to json_object
did not switch to the paid qwen/qwen3.8-27b endpoint
did not remove or weaken the strict schema requirement
did not substitute a different model
did not attempt a live completion call to empirically test response_format support
did not compile the generic TaskContract-to-JSON-Schema compiler (Section D/E of the request) since the experiment cannot proceed past this gate
did not freeze the 3-pack provider request bodies (Section J) since there is no confirmed schema to compile them with
